instability_diagnostic.scope: CPU checkpoint/array/CSV audit only. No extra inference or parameter changes. Finite weights and saved raw predictions do not establish a causal mechanism.

verification_scope: Source/config identity, checkpoint hashes, all 218 IDs and metric means checked. All twelve third-seed saved arrays independently rescored for nine metrics/counts, maximum difference zero; earlier reviews cover first/second seed arrays. Best/final weights contain only finite floating tensors, and final matches resume exactly, with identical job identity and complete history. Training code requires final detailed metrics to match online terminal validation and unchanged evaluation buffers. This CPU audit is not a new full inference or a causal explanation.
endpoint_selection: Post hoc review triggered by the severe seed-320114 endpoint deterioration. The same six fixed validation image IDs are used; no new image search, training intervention or checkpoint reselection.

endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0005: Best-to-final AbsRel 0.065634 to 0.245397, F1 0.368109 to 0. Depth becomes visibly blurred across table/chairs/wall; broad wall errors increase. All 1731 predicted edge pixels disappear under the fixed threshold; GT remains 3046.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0598: AbsRel 0.041195 to 0.101460, F1 0.534438 to 0. Table and sofa silhouettes become broad smooth transitions and legs disappear. Wall/floor error increases. Predicted edges 1309 to 0, fixed GT 2715.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_1440: AbsRel 0.093045 to 0.256696, F1 0.542980 to 0. Chair slats merge into a blurred region, wall and counter errors expand. Predicted edges 3434 to 0, fixed GT 3285.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0226: AbsRel 0.194463 to 0.261482, F1 0.507349 to 0.031072. Person, branches and furniture boundaries become strongly blurred; only a few head/seat fragments remain detected. Predicted edges 10909 to 302, so this example is severe loss but not exactly zero edges.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0246: AbsRel 0.149213 to 0.422268, F1 0.511607 to 0. Broad room-scale depth errors and halos replace relatively sharp foreground objects; thin stand remains absent. Predicted edges 3735 to 0, fixed GT 3559.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0080: AbsRel 0.053425 to 0.102285, F1 0.528721 to 0. Shelf/hat boundaries that were detected at best become smooth weak transitions. Left-wall error expands. Predicted edges 564 to 0, fixed GT 1628.

instability_interpretation: This is a recorded training/optimization instability, not a process crash and not merely a worse best checkpoint. The run ends normally under the frozen patience rule; its bad final checkpoint is retained.

At steps 900/1000/1100/1200/1300/1400/1500, validation AbsRel is 0.091248/0.098063/0.141566/0.209149/0.218471/0.187265/0.180190. Corresponding online training loss also rises after 900 (0.044428 to a peak 0.205533 at 1300), then partly recovers. The broad deterioration begins in the recorded 900-to-1100 interval; exact update onset and edge-onset are not available from 100-step metric sampling.

Because training and validation both deteriorate, calling this simply overfitting would be unsupported. The narrow predefined late_loss_down_val_up indicator is correctly false; false does not mean stable or healthy.

Final AbsRel is 99.92% above its own best. Across 218 images, 203 AbsRel values worsen, 212 F1 values worsen, zero F1 values improve and six tie. Images with zero detected prediction edges rise from 3 to 171. Total predicted edges fall 473274 to 10446 while GT stays 769528.

Saved parameters and twelve inspected raw arrays are finite; final/resume/history agree. Adapter L2 norm changes 5.2482 to 5.7812, refiner L2 6.3924 to 6.8198. These norms are descriptive and cannot isolate which component caused the behavior.

AMP skips occurred at 32,276,662,722, with no further skip during the observed late collapse. Final scaler is 8.0. This timing does not establish or exclude mixed-precision causality. No silent precision, batch, learning-rate or architecture change; no replacement run.

Zero detected edges means the depth discontinuity metric finds none above its fixed threshold; raw depth is finite and nonconstant. The final maps are visibly oversmoothed, so the F1 decline is supported by qualitative evidence as well as thresholded counts.

Best checkpoint remains the validation-selected step 500 and will be retained for the predeclared best comparison. Final remains in the stopping-behavior comparison. Excluding this seed would hide the reliability cost.
plot_observations: The complete curve now shows the third J400 loss and validation error rising sharply after about 900, in contrast to the other two seeds. The expanded vertical range is necessary; do not crop away the failure to show only near-best values.
All three best J400 values are close, but final values have large variation. Small best-checkpoint SD does not demonstrate stable optimization or safe fixed-duration training.
All R/L/J100/200/400 groups now have three seeds. J400 has lower selected mean error than J200, while L400 retains higher boundary F1. S and the other counts remain unfinished.

None of the three J400 runs meets the fixed 500-step terminal stability rule; all three confirm <=0.10 at step 300, and none confirms <=0.09 for three successive evaluations. Reaching a target early does not prevent later failure.

The stopping-performance figure includes the bad third seed, yielding mean final AbsRel 0.121073 and F1 0.294153. These are all-final summaries, not converged-model performance; there is no J400 stable-final subset.
conclusions: J400 minus matched J200 best: AbsRel -0.00390995 (about 4.17% lower), CI [-0.00715699,-0.00069359]; RMSE -0.0147252 m, delta1 +0.00742679, F1 +0.00922014 also have favorable scene intervals excluding zero, and all seeds improve those means. Boundary-band error decreases in all seeds but its interval includes zero. These full-group results supersede the two-seed uncertainty for AbsRel/RMSE.

J400 minus matched L400 best: AbsRel -0.000710079 (about 0.78% lower), CI [-0.00254142,0.00101911], two seeds better/one worse. RMSE and delta1 intervals also include zero; the prior two-seed delta1 interval excluding zero is superseded. No established overall-accuracy advantage over LoRA.

Against L400, boundary F1 falls in all three seeds by mean 0.0111881, CI [-0.0170158,-0.00624652], while boundary-band AbsRel improves in all by 0.00609256, CI [-0.00856238,-0.00396641]. Better depth values near boundaries coexist with fewer/misaligned detected boundaries; do not collapse these into one edge-quality claim.

Against R400 best, only boundary-band AbsRel has an interval excluding zero (-0.00818318; CI [-0.0120205,-0.00401482]). AbsRel, RMSE, delta1 and F1 intervals include zero. The earlier two-seed favorable RMSE interval is superseded.

Against B0 best, four depth-value metrics improve with conditional intervals excluding zero: AbsRel -0.0310379, RMSE -0.0718552 m, delta1 +0.0605606, boundary-band error -0.0356734. F1 difference +0.00383244 has CI [-0.00412977,0.01131327]; no established F1 gain over original.

Final means +/- SD: AbsRel 0.1210728 +/- 0.0512226; RMSE 0.5146375 +/- 0.1961915 m; delta1 0.8319226 +/- 0.1593855; F1 0.2941528 +/- 0.2437211; boundary-band error 0.1720683 +/- 0.0445120. Endpoint degradation is dominated by seed 320114 and must be reported alongside each seed, not described as uniform behavior.

Mean best/stop attempts are 1366.67/2366.67; stable runs 0/3. Total recorded time 1577.51 +/- 536.79 s includes training/validation/scoring and excludes separately documented shared setup. J is slower than L400 mean 852.89 s in this run collection; these are not isolated device benchmarks.

Trainable parameters 100817, peak allocated memory 4166.52 MiB. AMP skips 2/3/4; successful updates 3198/2397/1496. No formal run retry or configuration change. Keep all three best/final/resume checkpoints and full histories.

Continue the original queue: 300 then 500, followed by S100/S400, R/L/J577, and remaining S counts. The new instability does not authorize retuning or discarding a seed. After all 72 stages and visual review, complete the frozen test protocol; no 795-image refit or architecture search.
statistics_limits: Three-seed SD and scene-cluster uncertainty answer different questions. Bootstrap: 62 clusters, 2000 replicates, seed 320119, preserving image weights. Intervals are conditional on these three seeds, descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. A severe single-seed failure may dominate endpoint means and is not a population failure-rate estimate. Validation has been used for checkpoint selection and test has historical exposure; no new test evaluation yet.
